# Excel Fixtures

- `simple_semantic_fixture.xlsx`
  - single-sheet harmonization path
  - clean `date + plot_id + variety + treatment + yield + moisture + plant_height + ignore` mapping
  - demonstrates `yield t/ha -> kg/ha` and `plant_height m -> cm`
  - includes one deliberately high `yield` value to trigger `outlier_candidate`
- `multi_sheet_fixture.xlsx`
  - two-sheet workbook
  - validates per-sheet block detection and multi-block commit/readback
  - demonstrates that `yield` and `moisture` land in the same canonical model from different sheets
- `noisy_fixture.xlsx`
  - sparse title row + two-row header + missing numeric values
  - includes an auxiliary sheet with no detected blocks to exercise parse provenance warnings
  - demonstrates canonical `yield` mapping from a different source column name (`yield_kg_ha`)
  - demonstrates `kg/ha` source-unit preservation alongside normalized `kg/ha`
  - includes duplicate key candidates, missing dimensions and an invalid date to exercise quality validation

The files are generated by:

- `tests/fixtures/generate_excel_fixtures.py`
